title: 日本語の森 N3 — 受身・使役・可能形 (Passive, Causative, and Potential Forms)
description: From 日本語の森. This N3 grammar lesson covers the three derived verb forms: passive (受身形 — られる/される), causative (使役形 — させる/せる), and potential (可能形 — られる/できる). Explains formation rules, when each is used, common mistakes, and the causative-passive combination (させられる). Examples from everyday life and workplace situations.
